blocker.summary: r459 implemented multisample EDRAM render target support in PinnedShaderRuntime, named by r458. Design: edram_image_ becomes the multisample image itself, persisted across draws with the same clear/load semantics as the 1x path (chosen over an automatic per-subpass resolve, which would have discarded not-yet-resolved samples between accumulating draws on the same target); it is resolved explicitly via vkCmdResolveImage into a new companion 1x image (edram_resolve_image_) exactly once, at present time in resolve_edram_to_target(), matching where the 1x resolve already happened. PipelineKey and the render-pass cache now key on sample_count; the sample_count==1 path is byte-for-byte unchanged. Verified: native ctest 11/11 (including ac6_native_xenos_tests), and a live probe against the real ISO confirms the MSAA rejection message is now completely gone (0 occurrences, was 1) with presented_frames=5 state=2 unchanged (no regression). The 9 remaining fallbacks now carry two reasons unrelated to MSAA: the already-known pinned-registry coverage gap (r456, 8 occurrences) and a new, not-yet-investigated 'partial render-target write masks are not qualified this cycle' (1 occurrence). Deliberately NOT established: the EDRAM tile origin/pitch geometry was NOT adjusted for sample_count > 1 -- there is no citable retail or oracle evidence in this repo for the exact per-tile sample layout, and guessing it would violate the project's no-plausible-rule-without-control discipline; this is flagged honestly rather than guessed, and is falsifiable once real MSAA content actually renders (no real draw reached this geometry yet -- all MSAA-eligible draws this run are still blocked by the unrelated registry-coverage gap). Named for r460: (1) the pinned-registry coverage gap (r456) likely needs an oracle session -- user decision, not to be spent unilaterally; (2) the new 'partial render-target write masks' rejection, unrelated to MSAA, not yet investigated. Still open, non-blocking: once the wiring is judged mature, reconsider the backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438/r454-r459); update tools/prepare.py/build.py to default to the current ISO path (r452/r453, convenience only).
